decisions.reason: The rye country bread builds directly on the firm's core rye baking know-how, so the firm can interpret customer response and refine it cheaply, and nothing suggests weak results.
The premium raisin stollen is the firm's flagship and won the German Bread Institute's gold medal again, which shows deep, proven competence in this product.
The seeded rye mixed bread is a close variant of the established bread range that fits existing knowledge and production processes, so keeping it carries little risk.

The dark malt rye bread draws on established rye expertise, but it has no reported results and overlaps with the other rye breads, so it is the most likely candidate if the bread range is trimmed again after the ancient grain bread was dropped.
The marzipan stollen sits beside the award-winning stollen line and uses the same confectionery know-how and seasonal gift demand.
